name: AndiFeedBot
description: Andi's news feed reader. The operator documents it as the agent that reads publishers' news feeds and news sitemaps for Andi's news coverage, and describes it as a special case of Andi-SearchBot in the way Googlebot-News is of Googlebot. Its scope is deliberately narrow: a robots.txt rule naming it applies to feed reading only, and otherwise Andi-SearchBot's rules apply.
